note: The sites the launcher offers. status: ready (built: its manifest is read from path), unprepared (real data identified, not built), locked (a candidate, with what real data exists). Coordinates are planetocentric latitude and east longitude, degrees. campaign: the story order of the regional sites (a story system may gate them; the launcher shows every ready site).

sites.name: Gale Crater
sites.blurb: Curiosity's landing area: Bradbury Landing, Yellowknife Bay and the road toward Mount Sharp.
sites.data: USGS Astrogeology MSL Gale merged DEM mosaic (1 m) and orthophoto mosaic (0.25 m), Calef and Parker 2016.

sites.name: Arcadia Planitia

sites.data: MOLA-HRSC blended DEM (200 m), USGS CTX exploration-zone mosaic (5 m), Viking MDIM 2.1 colour (232 m).

Imagery: USGS CTX human-exploration-zone mosaic (CTX: NASA / JPL / MSSS); colour: Viking MDIM 2.1, USGS / NASA / JPL (public domain). Below the data: generated, and labelled. A game, not a navigation product.

sites.name: Gusev / Columbia Hills
sites.blurb: Spirit's landing site and the hills it climbed: Husband Hill, Home Plate, and where it stopped in 2010.
sites.data: HiRISE stereo terrain models (1 m) and orthoimages (0.25 m) of the Columbia Hills from the HiRISE team; the MER Spirit traverse is published by NASA/JPL.

sites.name: Meridiani / Endurance
sites.blurb: Opportunity's plains: Eagle and Endurance craters, and 45 km of traverse to Endeavour.
sites.data: HiRISE coverage along Opportunity's traverse, with stereo terrain models (1 m) of Victoria and parts of Endeavour's rim; CTX (6 m) throughout; the traverse is published by NASA/JPL.
